viewing_check: Armitage estimate 60-100, current bid $30 (+22% premium). The valuable part is the two Armani Eau Pour Homme boxes (100ml and 50ml, discontinued classic, shown in old cellophane), the Aramis Life 100ml and the Acqua di Gio 50ml and YSL L'Homme 60ml. Check in person: that cellophane is intact and boxes are genuinely sealed, fill levels and sprayer, batch codes (fakes exist; Pierre Philippe 'alternative to Paco Rabanne' is a knock-off, worthless), and whether the two cellophane 6-miniature sets and Collection Homme box are complete. Rough resale if sold one by one on eBay: Armani 100ml about A$110-150, Armani 50ml about A$80-195, Aramis Life about A$100-267 (only one sale, A$267 on 7 Nov 2026), Acqua di Gio A$92-114, YSL L'Homme A$86-99, Boss A$50-90, Aramis spray about A$47, plus miniature sets and Lacoste (not priced). Total about A$600-900. Prices 2024-2026, mostly within 2 years, steady to rising for discontinued Armani/Aramis.
